title: Where Did Bob Put The File?
story: The quarterly report is due in 10 minutes.
Bob says he put it 'somewhere safe'.
When asked where, Bob said 'that's the point of safe'.
Find the real report and read out the report code.
objective: Find Bob's real quarterly report and submit its report code.

/home/bob/documents/work/report_draft.tx: This is the draft. The real one is hidden.
/home/bob/documents/work/meeting_notes.t: Action item: schedule a follow-up meeting about the meeting.
files./home/bob/documents/memes/2019/distracte: Bob has labelled the boyfriend 'me', the girlfriend 'work' and the other woman 'naps'.
/home/bob/documents/memes/2019/.quarterl: QUARTERLY REPORT - FINAL - v7 - REAL - USE THIS ONE
files./home/bob/documents/memes/2020/this_is_f: The dog is labelled 'production'. The fire is labelled 'also production'.

hints: Files whose names start with a dot are hidden from a plain ls.
ls -a shows hidden files. Bob loves his memes folder.
completion: Report delivered with 14 seconds to spare.
Management read only the word 'PANIC' and called an all-hands meeting.
Bob was promoted. Nobody knows why.
